name: Is it better to hire a professional painter or paint walls myself?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to hire a professional painter or paint walls myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a finish contractor provides seamless drywall prep and sharp, clean cut-in lines along baseboards, door casings, and ceilings. Homeowners doing DIY painting often spend multiple weekends moving furniture, taping, patching, and fixing roller marks, while a professional crew completes the work in a fraction of the time with professional tools. More importantly, finish contractors address underlying structural issues like shifting drywall joints, loose corner bead, or poor previous patches before painting. If you value a flawless surface and lack the equipment or time for thorough surface preparation, hiring a professional is worthwhile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a pro saves time, ensures flawless drywall patching, and delivers sharp edges along trim without visible roller marks or lap lines.
